title: Integer slice property passes to differences (V4(o))
statement: Assume (REP), (SL), (IMC)(c) and (RU). (REP) is the exact frozen statement of cmc_exists_massRepresentation: a current T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), U open, with M_W(T) < ∞ for every open W with compact closure in U has a Borel measure μ with μ(ℝ^P∖U) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, μ(W) = M_W(T) for open W, and an a.e. strongly measurable field ξ with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x and α and T(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ (plus a null-set clause not used here). (SL) is the exact frozen statement of cmc_slice_mass_bounds: for open U, T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) represented by (μ, ξ) and ∂T by (μ', ξ') (measures finite on compact subsets of U, a.e. strongly measurable fields, a.e. bounded by 1 in the coefficient norm) and L-Lipschitz f, there are currents A_t ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), B_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ', ∂A_t = B_t on forms supported off {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t−h<f<t}) for open W, and ∫_{(a,b)} M_W(∂A_t − B_t) dt ≤ L·μ(W ∩ {a<f<b}). (IMC)(c): for all P, n, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and integer multiplicity A, B ∈ 𝒟_n(U), the difference A − B is integer multiplicity. (RU) is the frozen statement of the sibling cbr_setIntegral_eq_of_integral_eq: if, in an open U ⊆ ℝ^P, three pairs (μ_i, ξ_i) (Borel measures finite on compact subsets of U, a.e. strongly measurable k-vector fields with |ξ_i(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e.) satisfy ∫ξ₁(ω)dμ₁ = ∫ξ₂(ω)dμ₂ + ∫ξ₃(ω)dμ₃ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U), then ∫_Bξ₁(ω)dμ₁ = ∫_Bξ₂(ω)dμ₂ + ∫_Bξ₃(ω)dμ₃ for every Borel B and every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Let d, P ∈ ℕ and T, Y ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) such that T, ∂T, Y and ∂Y have locally finite mass (M_W < ∞ for every open W with compact closure). If T and Y have the integer slice property, then so does T − Y. Here a current X ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) has the integer slice property (ISP) if for all admissible representations (μ, ξ) of X and (μ', ξ') of ∂X in ℝ^P (Borel measures finite on every compact set; a.e. strongly measurable fields of (d+1)- resp. d-vectors with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for a.e. x and every covector α, |·| the Euclidean coefficient norm covectorEuclideanNorm; X(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ and ∂X(η) = ∫ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms) and every Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ, every pair A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P), B ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ and B(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms has ∂A − B integer multiplicity (the predicate written out verbatim in the frozen statements of the siblings cbr_slice_property_of_weak_limit and cbr_cycle_isIntegerMultiplicity).
